description: Re-import the contractor's products & services from their connected Jobber account so drafts use current prices. Use when the contractor says they changed prices in Jobber or the price book looks out of date. Side effects: overwrites FieldDraft's stored names, prices and details with Jobber's and deactivates items deleted in Jobber; nothing is changed in Jobber. Fails if Jobber is not connected.
name: sync_price_book
title: Sync price book from Jobber
